mentions.name: Bezier
mentions.description: Bezier is a Mac-native vector design app positioned as an alternative to Figma and Sketch. It supports design tokens and flexbox layouts natively, exports designs directly to HTML rather than a fake preview mode, and is gaining full code-backed components for moving easily between code and design. Tokens and HTML export are working and it is nearly ready for first betas.
mentions.problem: The author has been frustrated for years by the gap between design and code; Figma has stagnated, with design tokens requiring a third-party plugin and responsive designs being painful to produce.
mentions.audience: Designers looking for a Figma/Sketch alternative that stays close to live code
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m making Bezier, a mac-native vector design app as an alternative to Figma and Sketch.
